description: This file contains utility functions for handling file uploads in the Playwright core server, including preparing files for upload, checking size limits, and managing file buffers.

methods.name: filesExceedUploadLimit
methods.description: Checks if the total size of given files exceeds the upload limit of 50MB.

methods.name: prepareFilesForUpload
methods.description: Prepares files for upload by handling payloads, local paths, streams, and buffers, including size checks and reading files into buffers if needed.
